children: Toronto, Ontario – TheNewswire - September 9, 2026 – Hybrid Power Solutions Inc.
(FSE: E092) (“Hybrid” or the “Company”), a Canadian manufacturer of portable and fuel-free power solutions, announces that it has established a larger manufacturing facility in Mississauga, Ontario.

The Mississauga facility is intended to support increased production capacity as the Company scales its fuel-free and hybrid portable power platforms. Production at the facility is planned to include dedicated lines for the Company’s Batt Pack product line and for Spark and Terra production, enabling Hybrid to better organize manufacturing by product family and respond to growing customer demand.

Francois Byrne, Founder and CEO of Hybrid Power Solutions Inc., said: “Having reached maximum capacity at our previous facility, we felt it was time to expand to the level required for our current and future demand. This new standalone building allows for greater manufacturing automation, improved access control for inventory and defence contracts, and outdoor secured storage for large trailered systems.”

Hybrid Power Solutions Inc. is a Canadian clean energy innovator listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange under the symbol "HPSS." The Company specializes in developing portable power systems that eliminate the need for fossil fuels in off-grid and remote applications. With a focus on environmental responsibility and technological innovation, Hybrid Power Solutions is committed to leading the clean energy transition.
